definition: conditionArena constructs the same existing basic arena from a Kripke frame and fact valuation. ConditionContingent, ConditionNecessary and ConditionImplication specialize the same arena predicates without any new policy. This exposes data-only frame/valuation roles to the existing configuration tool, which does not accept a three-carrier Arena parameter; no policy is discarded to fit a bound.
note: Analyst framework for #545, not independently established metaphysical applicability. See docs/notes/grounding-baseline-545.md for examples, exclusions, structural properties and strongest rival replies.
